source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Address-book search applies the same punctuation normalization to the query and stored value for five named phone fields before the existing comparison operator. It retains leading plus and selected dialing/letter characters. The added browser cases cover spaced and dotted WorkPhone inputs. This is not E164 conversion, arbitrary-field normalization or complete multiple-number/provider coverage. No search test ran.
title: Normalize both sides of the selected phone-field search
